findings.severity: important finite process-entry bound; no false admission observed
findings.site: runner.py run_stage recheck() immediately before Popen
findings.problem: run_stage ignores the deadline returned by final recheck and does not require a fresh clock be below it before Popen. Packet/authentication can exhaust the fixed stage or actual CPU finish window; a new child is still started and performs config/hash work before later guards reject.

findings.minimal_correction: Fail closed immediately before Popen when fresh now is at/after min(original fixed stage bound, returned current allocation bound); retain a nonincreasing effective deadline consistently or abort a shortened unfit packet, never renew. Keep Task2 source unchanged.
required_regressions: Costly final authentication exhausts fresh240/prime480 -> zero Popen.
Actual current CPU end-minus60 already expired at final recheck -> zero Popen.
Valid bounded stage still starts once and strict normal/reap/publication behavior remains.
findings.posthoc_guards_retained: Child and observe_child later reject; this finding is unnecessary process entry after expiry, not a demonstrated successful late timing/operational admission.
